scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 7 good with meaningful friction; 10 exceptional with negligible observed friction. Holistic judgment of observed portrait emulation only, not an average or win/loss reward.

reasons.overall_mobile: Playable and learnable across two fresh runs, with strong travel/aim assistance and coherent atmosphere. Combat attention management and coil/cover ambiguity remain meaningful friction.
reasons.controls: Large labeled thumb controls, tap aim, TURN and contextual ROUTE work visibly. Two-contact route/fire is possible. Target framing changes after aim and TOOLS adds a layer; manual movement and fine aim are unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, exposed-coil timing and return goals form a clear observed progression. Incoming threats create pressure, but stationary target focus and firing during armor waste health/ammo. Upload detail not separately observed.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial scene, rain, weapon animation, strong title and terminal screens. Dark geometry sometimes reduces target separation. Audio not assessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, contextual hold labels, paused map, distinct fresh/retry actions and explicit stats help learning. Recovery under fire and a crowded bottom control area demand attention; map supplies showed 0 so supply selection was not explored.
reasons.readability: Primary objective, health/ammo, numbered coil OFF states and receiver signs were readable at 390x844. Small spaced status/result typography and dark cover/coil distinction require closer inspection.
